title: The Mythril severity gate passes when the report has no issues list or an empty one, without checking whether the analysis succeeded, so a Mythril run that failed but still wrote JSON reads as "Mythril clean"

evidence.note: documented behaviour: issues empty or missing -> "Mythril clean", exit 0
the report type reads only issues; the success and error fields of a Mythril JSON report are ignored
issues ?? [] -> only Medium/High block -> otherwise exit 0
myth analyze ... -o json > reports/mythril-honeypot.json, then the gate reads that file

sibling_sites_checked: The slither job uses slither own --fail-medium exit code (test.yml:120-128), so it does not share this gap. The gate is the only consumer of the Mythril report. Whether Mythril 0.24.x exits 0 after printing an error report ({success: false, error, issues: []}) was not verified here: Mythril is not installed locally and nothing was installed (Phase 22 rule); if it exits non-zero the CI step fails first and the gap is limited to a malformed-but-parsable report.
severity_rationale: S2: CI drift that can hide an S0/S1 class defect: HoneypotChecker.sol is the on-chain honeypot test, and a regression there could let the bot buy tokens it cannot sell. The gate failing open needs a Mythril error that still exits 0, which is unverified, hence candidate.
recommendation: Phase 30 (Hardhat 3 and checker redeploy) or Phase 31 (blocking CI gates): fail unless report.success === true and report.error is empty; prove it with a fixture report {success: false, error: "x", issues: []}; pin the Mythril version so the report shape is known.
